title: Platform Genre Diversification
scenario: Calculate the 'genre diversity score' for each platform, defined as the number of distinct genres released per year.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR, release_year INT), ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR)
hint: Group by platform, release_year, then count distinct genre.
correctQuery: SELECT platform, release_year, COUNT(DISTINCT genre) as diversity_score FROM games g JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id GROUP BY platform, release_year;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR, release_year INT); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR);
